meta.parties: Supramanian Chetty v. Gunewardene Et Al

rules.statement: A deed of gift is not considered fraudulent if the donor was solvent at the time of the gift and the disposition did not cause them to become insolvent.
rules.supporting_quote: "neither a donation nor sale would be considered fraudulent if the donor or vendor were solvent at the time he made it, and if the disposition had not caused him to cease to be so."
